title: Rachel L Probable NDE 4535
content: When I blacked out, I began to fly or fall down a flight of stairs into a wall and right before I hit the wall I immediately stopped before impact. I began to float and found myself in an old English pub, dimly lit, with an old bartender wiping down glasses. He nodded to acknowledge my presence, and then I woke up to a doctor saying, 'Welcome back'.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes 'Septic shock, started to crash.' 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was in septic shock and began to crash, at which point I fell unconscious and had a vision.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness The entire time
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes The staircase I descended was indeed enclosed in wooden walls.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw an old man with a white beard behind the bar.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The old English pub in which I could fly.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Peace, a little confusion, as if I had been in the same place before
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain I still don't know what I believe, but I know that I am not afraid to die anymore.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Uncertain I still don't know what I believe, but I know that I am not afraid to die anymore.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I have ended unproductive relationships and sought to become a more motivated individual. I have found passion.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I have ended unproductive relationships and sought to become a more motivated individual. I have found passion. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes In uncommon circumstances, and only with certain individuals, I have obscure knowledge about them that I would not normally have, such as their favorite cake, their first word, things they have done in the past of which I have no prior knowledge.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The fact that I could fly was very comforting to me.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes One week. People were intrigued.
